nodes.title: INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values:
## PROMPT USAGE

### Predefined Prompts
Input the path in the Load Text Directory node that contains the folder with the predefined prompts.

The prompts from the folder will be fed into the User Prompt.

The filename_text will be the name of the saved image.

### Own User Prompt
Disconnect the input to the User Prompt and the input to the filename_prefix in the Image Save node.

You can now enter your own prompt in the User Prompt node.

## ARCHVIZ CONTROLLER
Set use_manual_prompt to True to use ONLY the User Prompt. Set use_manual_prompt to False to use the User Prompt in combination with the Presets.

With use_manual_prompt to False, set environment to desired archviz environment. Choose the desired lighting, composition and lens presets for the chosen environment.

Choose desired seed, control after generate, aspect ratio and megapixels (regardless of the state of use_manual_prompt).
